sources: Joel, Impett, Spielmann & MacDonald (2018), How interdependent are stay/leave decisions? On staying in the relationship for the sake of the romantic partner, Journal of Personality and Social Psychology 115(5), 805–824 – Study 1: 1,348 people in relationships, followed 10 weeks; Study 2: 500 people considering a breakup, followed 2 months; people who believed their partner was more dependent on the relationship were less likely to initiate a breakup, even when their own satisfaction or commitment was low.
